items.title: 🔴 LIVE: Ethiopian Premier League - Saint George vs Fasil Kenema
items.description: Live coverage of the biggest match in Ethiopian football. Saint George takes on Fasil Kenema at Addis Ababa Stadium. Pre-game analysis, live commentary, and post-match reactions.

items.title: Parliament Session: Budget Approval Debate
items.description: Live coverage of the Ethiopian Parliament as members debate and vote on the national budget for the upcoming fiscal year.

items.title: Timket Festival 2026 - Live from Gondar
items.description: Live broadcast of the Timket (Epiphany) celebration from Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar. Witness the centuries-old tradition as thousands gather for this UNESCO-recognized cultural event.

items.title: Ethiopian Music Awards 2026
items.description: Live from Millennium Hall, Addis Ababa - the biggest night in Ethiopian music. Watch your favorite artists compete for top honors with special performances throughout the night.

items.title: Prime Minister's Press Conference: New Economic Measures
items.description: The Prime Minister addresses the nation on new economic reforms and answers questions from the press. Live from the Office of the Prime Minister.

items.title: Dawn Ethiopia Morning Show - Live
items.description: Start your day with Ethiopia's favorite morning show. Live interviews, weather updates, and breaking news with Meseret Mulugeta.

items.title: Africa Cup Qualifier: Ethiopia vs Kenya
items.description: Live coverage of the crucial Africa Cup of Nations qualifier between Ethiopia and Kenya. The Walia Ibex battle for a spot in the continental tournament.

items.title: Great Ethiopian Run 2026
items.description: Live coverage of Africa's biggest mass participation run. Thousands of runners take to the streets of Addis Ababa in this celebrated annual event.
